name: PDS DEMO — Receipt Vision Chain (no Telegram/Google creds)

parameters.content:
## PDS DEMO — live receipt vision chain in n8n
Webhook POST supplies { image_url, go_key } per request (key never stored in n8n or the repo).
'Photo to Base64' is VERBATIM from W2; Parse applies the SAME validation as production, reading an OpenAI-compatible reply with a Gemini-shape fallback.
